column4: Full-body view of the porcelain maid doll from the character sheet hanging limp in mid-air like a marionette at rest: head bowed so the face is mostly hidden by orange hair, arms hanging softly with loose wrists, toes pointing down a little above nothing, skirt hanging still. Three-quarter front view, calm and eerie, not dramatic. No strings and no controller are drawn (strings are added later). The entire background is one flat pure chroma green (#00B140) with nothing else in it; the figure has a clean closed outline against it. Keep the face, flower ornament, ball joints and wrist rings consistent with the sheet.

The exact same lectern, red-orange book, camera, lighting and surroundings as the two references. The book is caught halfway: the cover is lifted and standing nearly upright, a fan of pages riffling up between the covers. Same framing so it can hard-cut between the closed and the open state.

Extreme close-up of the porcelain maid seen directly from behind: her long orange hair parts in the middle of the back and falls to both sides, revealing the pale porcelain nape and upper back with a seam line and a round brass-colored winding socket (a keyhole plate) in the center of the frame, empty — no key in it. The flower ornament and coal ribbon are visible at the upper right edge. Hair strands are bold flat shapes with lots of lively locks.

A single ornate winding key seen exactly face-on, its shaft pointing straight at the viewer so only the decorative bow shows: a flat flower-like bow with petal cutouts in orange and coal, centered, with its hub at the exact center of the image. Nothing else. The entire background is one flat pure chroma green (#00B140).

Extreme close-up of one eye of the porcelain maid doll, filling the frame horizontally: the eyelid is half closed and drowsy, long coal lashes, an orange iris partly hidden, a thin porcelain seam line running across the cheek below, orange hair strands crossing the edges of the frame. Peaceful, empty, waiting. Leave the space above the lashes clear.
